working_geometry_plain: The working L3 geometry is a finite quaternion I/J/K invariant layer carried by PEPS3D spinor-density anchors. Each finite site carries torch-native spinor-derived density data and finite quaternion unit actions. SymPy checks I*J=K, J*I=-K, and I*J*K=-1 exactly; Clifford Cl(0,2) checks negative-square and anticommutation structure; the local action paths I->J and J->I are order-sensitive. This is still a local finite layer lego, not terrain, Hopf/fibration, stacking, flux, Axis0, physics, or final manifold evidence.
